job.organization: Los Angeles County Office of Education

items.item_text: 01. PLEASE READ THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT: Answer the following questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. You are not expected to answer at the highest level of each of these items to be qualified. The application will be evaluated for minimum qualifications. Your responses to the supplemental questions below may also be used to determine your qualifications beyond the minimum qualification requirements for this classification in a training and experience (T&E) evaluation. Referring to your application/resume, listing "see resume", or incomplete responses will NOT qualify as a response to any question. Questions that are answered in this method will be considered INCOMPLETE and may result in DISQUALIFICATION. You are required to answer ALL of the supplemental questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. Your responses to these questions are subject to verification and may be assessed in subsequent examination parts. All experience, education, training, and certification must be included in your application in order to be considered. Any sign of deliberate misinformation or intentional exaggeration will result in disqualification from this examination process and possible bar from future employment opportunities with the Los Angeles County Office of Education (LACOE). Select "Yes" if you have read, understood, and agree to the above statements. Select "No" if you have read, understood, and DO NOT agree with the above statements and voluntarily withdraw your application for this position. Options: Yes | No

02. What is your highest level of education? Please Note: Proof of education will be required. Degrees must be earned from an institution of higher learning recognized by the Council for Higher Education. Foreign degrees and credit units require translation and equivalency established by an agency recognized by the Commission on Teacher Credentialing. Options: No education | High School Diploma or GED equivalent | Some college coursework but no degree | Associate's Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Doctorate Degree

03. How many years of experience do you have in business administration or business services management , involving project management, fiscal analysis, and budget administration? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | 1 year but less than 2 years | 2 years but less than 3 years | 3 years but less than 4 years | 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 or more years

04. Please describe your experience in business administration or business services management as it relates to this position. For each related experience, please include: a) Your job title(s) b) Name of the organization(s) c) Job duties/responsibilities related to the job areas described above, including project management, fiscal analysis, and budget administration responsibilities d) Length(s) of employment If no experience in this area, list "n/a".

05. Regarding your experience in business administration or business services management, how many years were in a managerial capacity involving supervision, resource budgeting, and policy development for a business unit? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | 1 year but less than 2 years | 2 years but less than 3 years | 3 years but less than 4 years | 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 or more years

06. Briefly describe your business experience in management including the supervision of employees, resources budgeting, and policy development for a business unit. For each related experience, please include: a) Your job title(s) b) Name of the organization(s) c) Job duties/responsibilities related to the job areas described above (i.e. supervising employees, resources budgeting, and policy development for a business unit) d) Length(s) of employment If no experience in this area, list "n/a".
